cd /workspace/mytests && timeout 600 python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, time, subprocess, sys, resource, random
req = "GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h.example\r\nContent-Length: 0\r\n\r\n"
data = req * 8000          # 8000 requests, 432000 bytes
rnd = random.Random(1)
# split into 50000 parts at random boundaries
cuts = sorted(rnd.sample(range(1, len(data)), 49999))
parts = []
prev = 0
for c in cuts + [len(data)]:
    parts.append({"case":"a","data": data[prev:c]}); prev = c
H=[{"Type":"headers","End_Stream":True,"data_to_transfered":[[":method","GET"]]}]
d = {"seed":"s","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":10,
     "cases":[{"name":"a","frames":H,"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h.example"}}],
     "events":[{"at":1,"kind":"headers","stream":0,"fields":[[":status","200"]],"end":True}],
     "channels":[{"name":"c","parts":parts}]}
s = json.dumps(d)
print('input bytes', len(s), 'parts', len(parts))
t=time.time()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-B','main.py'], cwd='/workspace/project', input=s.encode(), stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
el=time.time()-t
o=json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
print('elapsed %.2f'%el, 'requests', len(o['channels'][0]['requests']) if 'channels' in o else o, 'err', o.get('error'))
print('maxrss MB', resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN).ru_maxrss/1024)
print('committed last', o['channels'][0]['committed'][-1] if 'channels' in o else None)
EOF
